name: Belmonte Tirol
beschreibung: The Belmonte Tirol is a hotel situated in the municipality of Sillian in East Tyrol's Lienz district. Located in the upper Puster Valley close to the South Tyrolean border, the hotel features comfortably furnished guest rooms and spacious suites. Visitors enjoy access to an inviting wellness area with a sauna and steam room. The property serves as a scenic gateway for excursions into the Rieserferner-Ahrn Nature Park, while in winter, the slopes of the nearby Sillianer Bergbahnen ski resort are easily reached. The on-site restaurant treats diners to fine regional cuisine blending Tyrolean and Italian culinary traditions.
